evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28764 to 15 ppm, and it stayed at 2-5 ppm afterward
Ramp followed the setpoint within about 1 °C; a brief 9.5 °C overshoot at the start of growth settled to 750.0
Heater power fell from 82% during the ramp to 37-45% at hold, which fits holding temperature rather than ramping
Ar flow stayed at about 100 sccm and pressure at about 760 Torr, both steady

args.missing_evidence: Characterization of the sample after growth, and reference ranges from normal runs to judge the size of the overshoot.
